name: rhvoice-emscripten-lb
description: Proof of concept: the [RHVoice](https://github.com/RHVoice/RHVoice) speech synthesizer compiled to **WebAssembly** with Emscripten, driving the Luxembourgish voices **Mil** (male) and **Mia** (female), reading text from an HTML page and playing it back through the **Web Audio API** — no server.
